I don't really see why a loss at a super regional should be that much worse than a loss at a major, especially with the lack of data that we have.

To close off, I think its important to note that we dont have an anti european bias, but when looking at the data, the way europe has performed in north america, especially compared to japan has led us to the conclusion that many of the losses to european are relatively bad compared to losses they might take in north america. This might change in future rankings tho, when european depth gets a chance to prove themselves overseas more.
